title: Cape Reinga landscape
description: The far north of Northland: bushy, flatter trees, orange dirt, some big sandy areas, and noticeably elevated ground. Further south the same tip opens into flat fields, and it is one of the few places bamboo grows.

title: Taranaki farmland
description: Extremely flat farmland all over the Taranaki ring plain, with unusually thin roads and widely spaced fences. The cone volcano is the obvious confirmation but is often lost in cloud.

title: Central North Island pine plantations
description: The central plateau of the North Island is blanketed in commercial pine plantations, which wall the road on both sides, with some very odd isolated mountains around them.

title: West Manawatu-Whanganui farmland
description: Super flat farmland in the western half of Manawatu-Whanganui, with a mountain ridge away to the south-east. A lot of Generation 3 coverage on the small roads here.

title: Bamboo
description: Stands of bamboo by the road. It only grows in the warmer climates, so it points north — Northland above all, with a little in West Coast or Bay of Plenty. Of no use inside towns, where anyone may have planted it.

title: Otago long off-centre poletop
description: A markedly elongated version of the off-centre crossbar, where the crossarm sits well to one side of a long poletop. Almost exclusive to Otago.

title: Triple indent pole
description: A concrete pole carrying three indents rather than the usual one. The reliable way to spot it is the short section that separates the indents near the bottom of the pole. Useful but very rare, and not thoroughly researched.

title: Pointed poletop
description: The concrete pole top is finished in a spike rather than cut flat. It can be hard to see, and on the Otago/Canterbury border it is the feature that separates the two power companies — spiked top on one side, flat top on the other.

title: Long indent pole
description: A concrete pole whose indent runs all the way up to the top, where the support bars connect, rather than stopping short as on the common pole. Indents reaching the very top of the pole are exclusive to southern Hawke's Bay as far as the author knows.

title: Vertical 6-digit sticker
description: A long black vertical sticker with six digits and, unlike the common vertical sticker, no square beneath it. The starting digits narrow the region down: 01-12 leans Southland, 13-17 leans Otago, 3 is Marlborough and P is Manawatu. A few very rare North Island ones start with 8.

title: Generation 2 front-left smudge
description: A dark smudge on the lens at the front left of the Generation 2 car, sitting lower down than the side smudge and less blurry than it. Found around and north of Auckland.

title: Generation 2 top smudge with scribbles
description: A Generation 2 car showing a smudge directly overhead together with very obvious scribble-like streaks across the sky. Not every location in the area shows it, so its absence proves nothing.

title: Single line corners
description: A single road line painted on the inner side of a bend, with no line at all on the outer side. Concentrated in and around Taranaki. Watch out for the same marking appearing at the approach to small bridges, which happens in every region.
